meta.title: Peachy: Gallery, player and browser for Android
meta.description: Peachy is a local-first Android media workspace: your gallery, player and browser in one app. Media you add is kept in the app's library on your phone. Open source, with limits stated plainly.
meta.socialDescription: A local-first Android media workspace. Your gallery, player and browser in one app, with media kept in the app's library on your phone.

hero.lead: Browse your gallery, play media and open the web in one Android workspace. Media you add is kept in the app's library on your phone.

library.label: Library
library.alt: Peachy Android Library search screen with All selected and sample landscape photos in two columns.
library.caption: Photos and videos together, with albums, search and media management.

player.label: Player
player.alt: Peachy Android Player screen showing a sample clip with playback controls and a queue.
player.caption: A media player with smooth playback and essential controls.

browser.label: Browser
browser.alt: A NASA Science article showing a pink and blue cloud around a forming star, photographed by the Webb telescope.
browser.caption: Browse HTTPS sites and save supported video files with ad and tracker filtering.

featureDetails.title: Watch and read at your own pace.

items.title: Ad and tracker blocking
items.text: The browser uses a native Brave engine with bundled EasyList, EasyPrivacy and adult-site filters. Manage subscriptions, custom rules and site exceptions from its menu. WebView limits mean not every request can be filtered.

items.title: Sync with compatible devices
items.text: If you want to use a compatible device, connect it through Intiface Central (Buttplug.io). Peachy can sync the device to the sound of your video.

items.title: Manga reader (18+)
items.text: Browse the nHentai catalog by tag and read in the app. Zoom in, bookmark a page, or pick up where you left off.

items.title: Documents, with clear limits
items.text: View and edit PDFs and supported images on working copies. Word, Excel (including XLS/XLSX) and PowerPoint files can be imported and listed, but Office viewing and editing remain disabled, even when a debug build packages the optional engine.

storage.alt: A padlock lit from above against a dark graphite surface.
storage.title: Private storage, on your device.
storage.lead: Peachy's library is local-first: the media you add is kept in the app's storage on your phone. Local-first does not mean offline-only, and it is not a promise of anonymity.
storage.localText: Media you add lives in the app's storage on your device.
storage.networkText: The browser contacts sites and filter-list publishers; the manga catalog contacts nhentai. Translation sends page images or locally recognised text to your chosen provider after host consent. Updates contact GitHub; automatic daily checks are off by default.
storage.protectionText: A numeric password locks the interface; SQLCipher encrypts the database with a separate Keystore-protected key. Media files are not individually encrypted by Peachy: they rely on Android's app sandbox and device encryption, not protection against a compromised phone.

principles.title: Six principles, kept in view.
principles.lead: These principles guide what we build and how we explain its limits.

items.title: Privacy by design
items.text: Privacy is architectural, not a marketing guarantee.

items.title: Local-first
items.text: Local processing and storage where the application supports it.

platforms.title: Availability, stated plainly.
platforms.lead: Android is available today. Desktop and alternative networks are not.
platforms.note: Planned and research rows describe intent, not shipped software.

philosophy.title: Privacy should be the default, not a privilege
philosophy.statement: Your content belongs to you. Your software should respect that.
